the Kupffer cell, like the peritoneal resident macrophage, is an active participant in iron metabolism, and that the inflammatory state may be modeled in the isolated cell system.
the Kupffer cell is an iron‐processing cell which releases iron acquired from erythrophagocytozed red cells in a manner which is similar to the peritoneal exudate macrophage.
the isolated rat Kupffer cell is a functional iron recycling cell which releases iron at a rate comparable to that of the peritoneal resident macrophage.

iron metabolism in the Kupffer cell, a cell of the reticuloendothyelial system.
the role of the reticuloendotheial system in the regulation of body iron.
the metabolism of iron by Kupffer cells.

the iron metabolism of the isolated Kupffer cells is similar to that of the isolated peritoneal macrophone, and that the Kupffer cells of rats with turpentine‐abscesses have an iron metabolism that is similar to those of rats without abscesses.
the Kupffer cell is a functional analogue of the peritoneal and alveolar macrophage in iron metabolism.

the Kupffer cell, like the peritoneal exudate macrophage, is a cell capable of processing iron acquired by erythrophagocytesis, but is not capable of releasing the iron to the extracellular medium in an uncontrolled fashion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Kupffer cell has the capacity for iron metabolism, which is similar to the peritoneal resident macrophage.

the Kupffer cell is an erythrophagocyte which, like the peritoneal and alveolar macrophage, is capable of processing iron acquired by phagosomal digestion of red blood cells, and that the Kupffer cells of the rat are not unique in their response to serum from rats with inflammatory disease.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Kupffer cell is a major site of iron processing and release in vivo, with the capacity of this cell being influenced by a variety of factors.
iron release from the Kupffer cell is an active process, which may be enhanced by certain agents, and which is inhibited by inflammatory serum.
